scope.summary: Implement a vector object's stroke as an ordered stack of stroke entries paralleling fills, each accepting multiple stacked paint fills with per-fill opacity/blend, and carrying weight (per-side all/top/bottom/left/right/custom), align (center/inside/outside), caps (butt/round/projecting), joins (miter/round/bevel + miter angle/limit), dashes (N dash/gap pairs, dash cap, align-to-corners, dotted preset), arrowheads (start/end markers with scale/swap/alignment), and dynamic stroke (wobble frequency/wiggle/smoothen); caps/joins/arrowheads defined for open + closed + branching network endpoints (3+ incident edges resolved per edge).
acceptance_criteria: stroke stack + full attribute set + defined branching endpoints; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: strokes panel reachable via author_id
test: weight/align/caps/joins/dashes/arrowheads/dynamic applied; branching-endpoint cap/join resolved per incident edge (no undefined rendering)

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Strokes (weight, caps, joins, dashes, arrowheads)

risk_if_missed: No strokes; outlines + arrowheads + dashes missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
